events.event_hazard: Civil crisis and armed conflict in Libya (2011)
key_impacts: Emergency health response was mounted in the Nafusa Mountains following a civil crisis that erupted in February 2011.
Orthopaedic and trauma services were supported at Nalut Hospital during the height of the conflict.
Parts of the Nafusa Mountains were previously inaccessible during the conflict and later became accessible as control shifted.
By late August 2011, the National Transitional Council assumed control over most of the country.
Nalut Hospital received essential drugs and medical supplies, and 15+ health facilities received staffing, supplies and capacity-building support.
